CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_name" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" text NOT NULL,
  "resource_type" text NOT NULL,
  "snapshot" text,
  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "audit_logs_action_check_60f3d6d6" CHECK ("action" IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'RESTORE', 'LOGIN', 'LOGOUT', 'PASSWORD_CHANGE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bom_items" (
  "bom_id" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "material_id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity_per_unit" float8 NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."boms" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "effective_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "product_id" text NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."materials" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_stock" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "min_stock" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "reserved_qty" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "unit" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."products" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_bom_id" text,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "sku" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sales_order_items" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "product_id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sales_order_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sales_orders" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "customer" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stock_movements" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "material_id" text NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "reference" text,
  "reference_id" text,
  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "warehouse_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "stock_movements_type_check_0d816ad8" CHECK ("type" IN ('PURCHASE', 'SALE', 'RETURN', 'DAMAGE', 'TRANSFER', 'ADJUSTMENT', 'RESERVATION', 'RESERVATION_RELEASE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."warehouses" (
  "address" text,
  "code" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "tenant_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
